llm.summary: This skill is a coherent CellCog presentation-generation helper, with a supply-chain caution around unpinned CellCog installation commands.

dimensions.detail: The requested environment, including python3 and a CellCog API key, is proportionate for using an external slide-generation SDK/service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The documented npx, OpenClaw, and pip installation commands are unpinned and mutable; this is a real supply-chain hygiene concern but is disclosed and purpose-aligned rather than hidden behavior in this artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are focused on creating presentation chats, but they delegate detailed SDK guidance to the separate cellcog skill, so users should treat that external skill as part of the trust boundary.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The reviewed artifact contains no persistence mechanism, privilege escalation, background service, tool hijacking, or destructive local action.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently describes creating slide decks through CellCog, requiring python3, a CELLCOG_API_KEY, and the CellCog dependency, which fit the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust CellCog and are comfortable sending presentation prompts and any supplied files to its service. Prefer pinned or verified CellCog package versions where possible, protect CELLCOG_API_KEY as a secret, and review the separate cellcog skill before relying on its SDK instructions.
llm.findings:
[RP1] expected: The unpinned CellCog install command is present, but it is an explicit setup instruction for the named service dependency, not hidden or automatic execution by this skill.
[T08] expected: The dependency and delegated cellcog skill are expected for this integration; the risk is mutable supply-chain resolution and external instruction delegation, which warrants user caution but does not by itself make the skill suspicious.
